claudeTotalTokensJoin.explanation: With at least one token bucket, Claude emits canonical response totalTokens (including zero); totalContribution returns totalTokens; buildUsageIndex sums canonical contributions into cumulativeTokens; queryUsageIndex publishes usage.cumulativeTokens; derive agentTokens copies it to tokens.total.
